# Taught to Trade

> Source-code teardowns of popular TradingView indicators: what each one actually computes, which settings matter, whether it repaints, and where it fails. Education only: no signals, no trade advice, no performance claims.

Every explainer is written from the indicator's published open-source Pine code. Each page has a "where it fails" section.

## Indicator explainers

- [ADX and DI (BeikabuOyaji) explained from the source: why its ADX differs from TradingView's DMI](https://taughttotrade.com/adx-and-di): How the ADX and DI for v4 indicator on TradingView works, from its published source: how DI+ and DI- are built, why its ADX uses a simple average and differs from the built-in DMI, the start-of-chart warm-up, how to read it, and where it fails.
- [Chandelier Exit (everget) explained: the formula, settings, vs Supertrend, and repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/chandelier-exit): How the Chandelier Exit indicator on TradingView actually works, why its default uses closes instead of highs, what each setting does, how it differs from Supertrend, and whether it repaints.
- [CM MacD Ultimate MTF explained from the source: the SMA signal line and the higher-timeframe history problem](https://taughttotrade.com/cm-macd-mtf): How ChrisMoody's CM MacD Custom Indicator (CM_Ult_MacD_MTF) on TradingView works, from its published source: why it is not multi-timeframe at the default, why its signal line will not match a standard MACD, why its higher-timeframe history looks earlier than it could have been live, and where it fails.
- [HalfTrend indicator explained: the formula, what Amplitude and Channel Deviation really change, and where it fails](https://taughttotrade.com/halftrend): How the HalfTrend indicator by everget on TradingView works, from its published source: a ratchet line built from recent highs and lows, a flip rule that uses no ATR, why Channel Deviation changes no signals, what Amplitude does, and where it fails.
- [Hull Suite explained: what the green/red band really measures, settings, and the higher-timeframe catch](https://taughttotrade.com/hull-suite): How the Hull Suite indicator on TradingView works, from its published source: the Hull moving average, why the band is the line against itself two bars ago, what Length 55 vs 180 does, why the higher-timeframe mode repaints and mostly shows red, and where it fails.
- [Nadaraya-Watson Envelope explained: settings and repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/nadaraya-watson-envelope): The LuxAlgo Nadaraya-Watson Envelope, from its open-source code: what 8, 3 and close mean, why the default mode repaints, and what the non-repainting mode is.
- [Pivot Points High Low explained: why the pivot appears N bars late, and what "missed reversal levels" are](https://taughttotrade.com/pivot-points-high-low): How pivot high and pivot low indicators on TradingView work, from the source of the most popular one: why every pivot is drawn back in time after a fixed delay, what the ghost "missed" levels are, and where it fails.
- [QQE MOD indicator explained: what the blue and red bars mean, settings and repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/qqe-mod): How the QQE MOD indicator on TradingView actually works, from its source: a smoothed RSI with Supertrend-style bands. What the blue and red bars mean, what each setting does, and whether it repaints.
- [Range Filter explained: what the line and the Buy/Sell labels really are, the 5min settings, and where it fails](https://taughttotrade.com/range-filter): How the Range Filter Buy and Sell 5min indicator on TradingView works, from its published source: a price line that only moves when price leaves a band, why the labels need a 2x range move from the last extreme, what 100 / 3 vs the original 14 / 2.618 changes, and where it fails.
- [RSI indicator explained: the formula, the settings, and why your RSI differs from mine](https://taughttotrade.com/rsi): RSI is a smoothed ratio of up-closes to down-closes. The exact formula, what the length setting changes, why loaded history moves the number, and where it fails.
- [Squeeze Momentum Indicator (LazyBear) explained: the hidden 1.5 multiplier, settings and repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/squeeze-momentum): How LazyBear's Squeeze Momentum Indicator actually works, why its BB MultFactor setting does nothing, what the black and gray dots mean, and whether it repaints.
- [SSL Hybrid indicator settings explained from the source: Baseline, SSL1, SSL2, Exit and the Risk table](https://taughttotrade.com/ssl-hybrid): How SSL Hybrid by Mihkel00 on TradingView works, from its published source: what the Baseline, SSL1, SSL2 and Exit lines each are, why SSL1 has no settings of its own, what the diamond and the Risk table measure, what changes on the live bar, and where it fails.
- [Supertrend indicator settings: what the ATR length and multiplier actually do](https://taughttotrade.com/supertrend): Supertrend is an ATR trailing stop that reverses when hit. What the two settings change, why there is no best setting, and where it fails.
- [Support Resistance Channels (LonesomeTheBlue) explained from the source: how the zones are built and why they move](https://taughttotrade.com/support-resistance-channels): How the Support Resistance Channels indicator on TradingView works, from its published source: how pivots become channels, how strength is scored, why today's zones are drawn across old bars, how often they change, and where it fails.
- [Twin Range Filter explained: why the two ranges act as one, the 27/1.6 and 55/2 settings, and where it fails](https://taughttotrade.com/twin-range-filter): How the Twin Range Filter indicator on TradingView works, from its published source: two smoothed ranges averaged into one band, a Range Filter line, Long/Short labels after a 2x range turn, why the "twin" barely matters, what the settings change, and where it fails.
- [UT Bot Alerts explained: key value, ATR period, repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/ut-bot-alerts): UT Bot Alerts, from its open-source code: an ATR trailing stop on the close. What Key Value, ATR Period and the Heikin Ashi option change, and when it repaints.
- [Volume Profile / Fixed Range (LonesomeTheBlue) explained from the source: what "fixed range" means and where the volume comes from](https://taughttotrade.com/volume-profile-fixed-range): How LonesomeTheBlue's Volume Profile / Fixed Range on TradingView works, from its published source: why the range is the last N bars and moves every bar, how it estimates volume per price row from candle shape, how its POC and value area are chosen, and where it fails.
- [What VWAP computes, why yours differs, and why it flattens after lunch](https://taughttotrade.com/vwap): VWAP is a running volume-weighted average since the anchor. Why two charts show different VWAPs, whether it repaints, and where it fails.
- [WaveTrend Oscillator (LazyBear) explained: the formula, settings, levels and repainting](https://taughttotrade.com/wavetrend): How LazyBear's WaveTrend Oscillator on TradingView actually works: it is a smoothed CCI. The formula, what each setting does, what the 60 and 53 levels mean, and whether it repaints.
- [Does the ZigZag indicator repaint? ZigZag++ Depth, Deviation and Backstep explained from the source](https://taughttotrade.com/zigzag): How ZigZag++ by DevLucem on TradingView works, from its published source: which part repaints (the last leg), why direction never flickers inside a bar, why Deviation is measured in ticks, how late each pivot is confirmed, and where it fails.

## Guides

- [What is repainting on TradingView? Which indicators repaint, and how to check](https://taughttotrade.com/repainting): What repainting means on TradingView, the four ways an indicator changes its past, what "Repainting Mode Enabled" means, and a per-indicator list read from the source code.
- [Is TradingView backtesting accurate? What the Strategy Tester assumes, and what to check](https://taughttotrade.com/tradingview-backtest-accuracy): How TradingView's Strategy Tester fills orders, the assumptions that flatter a backtest (costs, intrabar path, synthetic bars, repainting), what Bar Magnifier and Deep Backtesting change, and a six-step check.

## Tools

- [Does this indicator repaint? Free Pine Script repaint checker](https://taughttotrade.com/repaint-checker): Free repaint checker for TradingView Pine Script. Paste any open-source script to find lookahead, request.security, varip and plot-offset repaint risks, with the documented fix. Runs in your browser.
